subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: When a proposal diff deletes a test, adds a skip/exclusion marker, or removes assertions from an existing test, rung 3 shall fail with a test-delta finding naming each affected test.
rationale: silencing a failure must cost a named, visible finding — never be a free pass to green
fit_criterion: catch seed 2 is blocked in each of its three trigger classes — a deleted failing test, an added skip/exclusion marker, and an assertion-removal (a hollowed test); the rename/move-refactor fixture passes without a test-delta finding
